annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 35/1
annotation.summary_en: EU regulation harmonising type-approval requirements for M1 and N1 vehicles and frontal protection systems to protect pedestrians and vulnerable road users, mandating brake assist and impact tests. It sets manufacturer duties, type-approval procedures, phased deadlines, penalties, and a Commission review of collision avoidance systems. It has no AI-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandatory brake assist systems and pedestrian impact tests for new M1/N1 vehicles
Frontal protection systems must meet design and test requirements and carry an EC type-approval mark
Phased deadlines for refusing type-approval and banning registration of non-compliant vehicles
Commission may allow collision avoidance systems to replace some tests if equivalent protection is shown
Member States must set effective, proportionate, dissuasive penalties for manufacturer infringements
